title: Correct B1 formula
description: Essential: Student must derive or state B1 = (1/R) * sqrt(2(m/e)V0) for the deflection field.

title: Correct B formula
description: Essential: Student must derive or state B = (4/R) * sqrt(2(m/e)V0) for the toroidal field giving four foci.

title: Numerical answers
description: Essential: Student must compute B1 ≈ 3.7e-3 T and B ≈ 1.48e-2 T with correct units (T or Vs/m²).

title: Lorentz force application
description: Important: Student applies F = e v B for centripetal force, equating m v²/R = e v B1 for part (1).

title: Velocity from energy
description: Important: Student uses energy conservation (1/2 m v0² = e V0) to express v0 in terms of V0 and e/m.

title: Cyclotron motion analysis
description: Important: For part (2), student finds gyration period T = 2πm/(eB) and relates focus spacing b = v∥0 T.

title: Focus spacing condition
description: Important: Student correctly states that four foci per toroid circumference means b = (2πR)/4 = πR/2.

title: Small-angle approximation
description: Optional: Student notes v∥0 ≈ v0 due to small aperture angle, simplifying the focus distance calculation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student shows unit analysis for final magnetic field expressions, confirming Vs/m² or Tesla.

title: Sign or vector error
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect Lorentz force sign (e.g., +e(v×B)) or misplaces cross-product order.

title: Focus spacing mistake
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly relates focus spacing to circumference (e.g., uses b = 2πR or b = R).
